title: Verify that the KRN-041 export fixes reproduce from main and record their integration status
acceptance: The KRN-041 procedure is rerun from the primary checkout on a fresh run name and its pass/fail, check count and exit code are recorded.

The rerun's relinked kernel, stub object and export profile are compared with the accepted run-003; any byte difference is explained by inspection (machine code, sections, embedded strings), not assumed.
Whether 0001/0002 are applied by any project source-preparation or build tool in main is stated with the search used; nothing is claimed about booting.
